newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Grand Hotel shares surge on sale.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Grand Hotel shares surge on sale.

text.p: Shares in Grand Hotel Group Ltd leapt over seven percent to A$1.92 on Friday after an announcement late on Thursday that ING Barings had sold its 39 percent stake to Singapore's Tuan Sing Holdings Ltd for A$2.05 per share or A$80.7 million.
ING Barings came to own the stake through its former stake in underwriters to the Grand Hotel Float, McIntosh Securities Ltd.
The Grand Hotel float was poorly received by investors and ING Barings and McIntosh were forced to take up just under half the stock.
Brokers said the sale and consequent exit of a reluctant major shareholder had removed a major source of uncertainty.
"It's obviously good news for the stock with that share overhang having found a home," said a Sydney-based dealer.
"It has taken a lot of pressure off the share price."
The sale remains subject to shareholder approval after an independent expert's report.
